d:
Thanks so much for taking the time to read my translation.

All the typesetting, redrawing, and translating was done by me over the course of about a week.

I would appreciate any donations as its quite time consuming to maintain a decent quality while doing this by myself.

I really enjoyed translating Tonelico's sister's descent into debaucherous hito-loving mating, and I hope everyone who reads does too.

If you apprecite the work put into this translation you can donate at:
http://www.paypal.me/sadieandherbroom

You can also message me on Discord @NuwaNightstone if you want to request a specific doujinshi's translation or commission a translation of something, though I can't guarantee I'll translate anything as usually I want to have at least a passing interest in a doujinshi before translating it. (this one was on my list for a while)

This translation was requested by Apathanatismos.

I appreciate you all, Thanks so much!!
n: [Doujinshi] The Press Secretary's Secret Report 2 [KAWAZOKO (Kikunyi)] Tonelico Houdoukan no Ura Houkokusho 2 [English] [Digital]
